label: Peplink MAX BR1 Mini M2M (HW3)
description: Compact M2M router, hardware revision 3: 0/1x GE WAN, 2/1x GE LAN, 300 Mbps throughput, Wi-Fi, PoE in.
notes: Vendor figures from the BR1 Mini M2M HW3 datasheet: Ethernet WAN port **0 / 1 (GE)**, LAN port **2 / 1 (GE)** under PrimeCare, Router Throughput 300 Mbps, Wi-Fi AP Yes, PoE Input Yes. **This HW3 M2M is gigabit**, unlike the older MAX BR1 Industrial M2M in this catalogue which has fast-Ethernet ports and a 100 Mbps ceiling - the same product name, a different hardware revision, and a ten-times throughput difference.
